idea-plugin.name: VueKit(Vue开发工具包)
idea-plugin.description:
VueKit (Vue Development Toolkit)

A comprehensive IntelliJ IDEA plugin for Vue.js developers, providing intelligent component completion, documentation, and advanced development assistance features.

Main Features:

  • Smart Component Completion - Supports major UI component libraries including Element Plus, Element UI, and Ant Design Vue
  • Intelligent Property Suggestions - Provides smart suggestions for attributes, events, and slots based on component type
  • Real-time Documentation Display - Displays detailed component documentation and usage examples on hover or selection
  • Multi-library Support - Automatically detects component libraries used in projects, supports manual configuration
  • Custom Component Libraries - Supports importing and managing custom component libraries
  • Right-click Documentation - Quickly access detailed component/attribute/event documentation via right-click menu
  • Remote Component Library Management - Download and manage component libraries from official marketplace

Supported Component Libraries:

  • Element Plus (Latest Version)
  • Element UI (Classic Version)
  • Ant Design Vue
  • Custom Component Libraries
  • Remote Component Libraries

Use Cases:

  • Vue.js project development
  • Component library documentation lookup
  • Code completion and suggestions
  • Development efficiency enhancement
  • Remote component library management
